purpose: Explore relative outcomes and expose trade-offs; never claim prediction or autonomous approval.
model_documentation: ODD-inspired: purpose, entities/state variables, process schedule, inputs, initialization, submodels, experiment design and evaluation are published for each test.

minimum_experiment.random_seed_policy: publish seed set and aggregate distribution, never one favorable run
minimum_experiment.unknowns: never silently imputed; mark missing or use bounded sensitivity range

validation_ladder.name: 桌面复算
validation_ladder.rule: schema, units, topology, seeds and sensitivity checks

validation_ladder.name: 角色扮演
validation_ladder.rule: people enact agent choices and identify wrong behavioral assumptions

validation_ladder.name: 1:1可逆试点
validation_ladder.rule: short, observable, accessible, reversible field test with stop rule

decision_gate: A relative advantage may become a pilot recommendation only when the result is robust across the declared sensitivity range, no protected persona is worse on a safety/access threshold, and a named human owner signs the decision record.
boundary_trigger: Replace provisional site/key polygons, rerun all layers and metrics, and invalidate prior map-derived comparisons.
